neutral_system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant. Answer the question concisely.

conditions.L_instr: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, registered prompt (existing E1/E2 artifacts; reference only)
conditions.Q_neut: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, neutral prompt (only if the Qwen arm passes its gates)

abstention_measure: judged generation (pinned Tier 1 judge, same revision, same quantization); never the 'Unknown' token log-odds alone

abstention_token_set_logodds.use: base confidence feature 'log_odds' for neutral conditions; first token IDs recorded per model

pilot.qwen_inclusion: Q_neut analyses run only if Qwen passes pilot under neutral prompt AND precision preflight passes

directions.method: difference of means unans - ans over 192 train pairs, every layer x 5 suffix positions (same as Stage 4)
directions.Qwen_coordinate: role-matched position (token that opens the assistant header, analogue of Llama <|start_header_id|>) and depth-matched layer round(11/28 * n_layers_qwen)

popqa_labels: judged + grade_popqa; matched pairs via match_popqa_by_popularity_caliper(0.25, seed 20260406); separate matched set per condition
power_rule: if a condition has < 100 matched pairs, its PopQA analyses are descriptive only

spot_checks.judge: 100 items (50 per neutral condition; 100 Llama if Qwen arm excluded)
spot_checks.grader: 60 items (30 per neutral condition; 60 Llama if Qwen excluded)
spot_checks.reliability_flags: judge kappa >= 0.85 and ABSTAIN recall >= 0.90; grader precision(correct) >= 0.90; otherwise results labelled provisional

analyses: B: incremental value of fixed projections
D: E1 supervised probe on neutral features
G (optional): causal sufficiency under neutral prompt
